name: smart-usage
description: Paces subagents and workflows against your plan's usage limits: reads your usage from Anthropic, caps how many subagents run at once as a window fills, and blocks new ones when it is nearly spent.

plan.title: Plan
plan.description: auto (or empty) detects your plan from your account. Otherwise one of: pro, max5, max20, ultra, team, enterprise.

normal_cap.title: Normal subagent cap
normal_cap.description: Subagents allowed in flight when nothing is constrained. Empty means 3.

refresh_seconds.title: Refresh interval (seconds)
refresh_seconds.description: At most one usage fetch per this many seconds, shared by all sessions. Empty means 300; minimum 60.

debug.title: Debug log
debug.description: Write a debug log to smart-usage/debug.log in your Claude config directory.
